title: Find any card
subtitle: Search your collections and the full card catalog at once

steps.openSearch: Open search from Home, or press Ctrl and / anywhere in the app.
steps.typeName: Type part of a card's name.
steps.readResults: Your own copies come first, then every printing in the catalog.
steps.openCard: Pick a result to open it.
